youtubeTitle: Her family's farming barely covered expenses. She switched crops - and her income finally caught up.
caption:
Her family's farming barely covered expenses. She switched crops - and her income finally caught up.

Purnima, from Balrampur district, Chhattisgarh, struggled alongside her family with conventional farming that didn't cover daily expenses. She joined a Self-Help Group and became a 'Lakhpati Didi,' using a bank loan and Community Investment Fund support to switch to organic farming - specifically Jiraphool, an aromatic rice variety with rising market demand. Her income now covers household expenses and her children's education and lets her help others in need. She met Chhattisgarh's Chief Minister, who praised rural women's growing economic participation. One crop change, one Self-Help Group and a household that finally has room to breathe.
